Cash rate decision, September

At its meeting today the Board decided to raise the cash rate target by 25 basis points to 4.60 per cent. It also increased the interest rate paid on settlement balances to 4.50 per cent.

Inflation has fallen substantially since its peak but remains above the midpoint of the target band. The Board judged that a further tightening was warranted to keep the return to target on track, and noted that the outlook remains uncertain.
